samples.summary: Substantial unrequested scope bundled with the #1050 fix: a whole peer-attribute hardening program (fontSize / lineHeight / cell padding / image size bands, `row-height.ts`, and a new `MAX_ROW_PAGE_SPAN` bound inside `paginateLayout`) rides along with the list-subtree gesture change. Only the `listLevel` band is arguably entailed by #1050 (the planner reads the field); the row-height and pagination-loop work is an independent DoS-hardening concern touching a different subsystem (pagination/tables), with its own new modules, new public exports on two entry points, and its own design-doc section. Cost stays inside the repo (review burden, one revert surface for two unrelated behaviours) rather than breaking the stated outcome, so minor — but it should have been a separate change, or the issue text should authorize it.

Design-doc filing: the new pagination invariant (`paginateLayout` bounds its row-split loop to `MAX_ROW_PAGE_SPAN` = 200 pages and refuses non-positive fragments, clipping content past the bound) is documented in a new subsection of `docs/design/docs/docs.md` under *list handling*, not in the canonical docs for that code — `docs/design/docs/docs-pagination.md` (which already has a whole section on `paginateLayout`'s clamp-rather-than-throw policy, ~line 120) and `docs/design/docs/tables/docs-table-row-splitting.md` (which specifies the row-split algorithm this loop implements and still says a row that doesn't fit is pushed/clipped by the old rules). The repo folds behaviour into the canonical subsystem doc; recording a pagination bound in the list-handling section of the umbrella doc leaves the two table/pagination docs describing an unbounded loop.

`MAX_FONT_SIZE = 400` in the docs model duplicates the frontend's `FONT_SIZE_MAX = 400` (`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts:74`) and contradicts an explicit documented decision: `docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:224-226` states `FONT_SIZE_MIN`/`FONT_SIZE_MAX` "live in the frontend's font-catalog.ts, not in the docs engine package — the docs package has no opinion on legal size bounds". The change gives the docs package exactly such an opinion, in a second copy of the same number, without updating that doc. If the picker's ceiling ever rises, legitimate user font sizes will be silently read as *absent* (falling back to the default) at both CRDT read boundaries — two answers to the same question. Either derive the band from the shared constant (move it to `@wafflebase/core` / the docs model and have the picker import it) or amend docs-font-controls.md.

Reuse missed / second copy of the band: the clipboard sanitizer now imports `MAX_LIST_LEVEL` from the new module but still reimplements the clamp inline (`Math.min(MAX_LIST_LEVEL, Math.max(0, Math.trunc(level)))`) instead of calling `normalizeListLevel`, whose whole stated purpose in `model/list-level.ts` is that "the band has one definition". The two differ already in rounding (`Math.trunc` vs `Math.floor`) and in how a missing value is spelled, so any future change to the normalizer (e.g. NaN handling) silently applies to every path except paste.

`walkCellsForSiblings` is a near-verbatim copy of the adjacent `walkCellsForBlock` — same recursion over rows/cells, differing only in whether it returns the found block or its containing array. One walker returning the `{ blocks, block }` pair (or `walkCellsForBlock` implemented on top of the sibling walk) would keep the two traversals from drifting as table nesting rules change.

`normalizeRowHeights` (the array form) has no caller anywhere in the repo and is not re-exported from either entry point — dead API surface added by the change; the array sites (`crdt-tree.ts`, `yorkie-doc-store.ts`) all map `normalizeRowHeight` themselves.

Doc/code mismatch in the new section: "All six writers route through it" then names seven (`handleTab`, `handleIndent`, `handleOutdent` in `text-editor.ts`, plus the `indent`/`outdent` pair in each of `editor.ts` and `text-box-editor.ts`).
